info.title: Finance tracker API
info.description: The data of the signed-in user. Accounts and sign-in are Firebase Authentication: send the Firebase ID token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Amounts are integers in minor units (grosze, cents) with an ISO 4217 code.

source.description: nbp-a = NBP table A; ecb = the fallback when NBP fails

date.description: The day of the table that answered

requested.description: The day that was asked for

rates.description: PLN per 1 unit of each currency

rate.description: Units of `to` for one unit of `from`

get.summary: Liveness check; it does not touch Firestore
Mid rates of a day (NBP table A; ECB when NBP fails). A day without a table gets the last one before it
Bank buy and sell rates (NBP table C), the latest
The mid rate of one currency on every day with a table, at most 366 days
Convert an amount in minor units at the mid rates of a day
The signed-in user and their settings (defaults until they change one)

patch.summary: Change some settings; the fields that are not sent keep their value

get.summary: Transactions between two days (at most 400), newest first, optionally filtered

schema.description: Text in the note, payee or tags

parameters.description: Text in the note, payee or tags
parameters.name: q

post.summary: Copy the transactions of version 1 (personal-finance-manager) once into a new PLN account

get.summary: The savings goals with what is saved in each

post.summary: Add a goal; linked to an account, its balance is the progress

delete.summary: Delete a goal and its contributions

get.summary: Money put in and taken out of a goal, newest first

post.summary: Put money in (positive) or take it out (negative)
